Farm Vaidya
Farm Vaidya is an organization developing agricultural solutions powered by Gen AI technology, focused on improving access for smallholder farmers in India.<SEP>Farm Vaidya is an organization that provides Generative AI-powered conversational solutions aimed at improving agriculture.<SEP>Farm Vaidya is an organization founded to utilize Generative AI-driven voice technology for providing agricultural knowledge to farmers.

Agri-Input Organizations
Agri-Input Organizations refer to companies that provide agricultural inputs and support services, working with Farm Vaidya to enhance farmer accessibility to information.

30,000 Hours
30,000 hours of conversational agricultural audio is being collected for the development of an advanced STT system that captures diverse dialects.

Rythuvaani
Rythuvaani is a project focused on creating a Telugu agriculture domain-specific dataset for building a Speech-to-Text (STT) system.<SEP>Rythuvaani is a project under Farm Vaidya focusing on agricultural voice solutions.

Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) refers to technology for converting spoken language into text, specifically tailored for agricultural terminology in India.

Gen AI
Gen AI refers to advanced artificial intelligence technologies that revolutionize agricultural intelligence by providing innovative solutions.

Voice Agent
The Voice Agent is an AI-powered conversational tool that enables agricultural organizations to provide support in regional languages.<SEP>The Voice Agent is a type of conversational AI developed by Farm Vaidya to provide personalized agricultural solutions.

Telugu
Telugu is one of the regional languages employed in Farm Vaidya’s solutions, particularly in developing voice agents and datasets.

Multilingual Interactions
Multilingual Interactions involve communication in multiple languages, facilitated by Farm Vaidya's technologies to support farmers across different regions in India.

ChatBot
ChatBot is an AI-powered tool designed for structured text-based engagement to answer product-related queries and assist users in local languages across digital platforms.<SEP>The ChatBot is part of Farm Vaidya's offerings, designed to assist users with agricultural queries through conversational interactions.

Indian Smallholder Farmers
Indian Smallholder Farmers are the target audience that Farm Vaidya aims to empower through Generative AI technology.

Website Voice Agent
The Website Voice Agent refers to the online platform version of Farm Vaidya's voice solutions aimed at enhancing user interaction.

Telephone Voice Agent
The Telephone Voice Agent is a specific application of Farm Vaidya's conversational AI solutions targeting telephonic agricultural assistance.

Agricultural Extension Officers
Agricultural Extension Officers are experienced professionals contributing to Farm Vaidya’s mission of bridging knowledge gaps in agriculture.

AI Engineers
AI Engineers are part of the team at Farm Vaidya working on developing and implementing Generative AI solutions.

G Jyotsna
G Jyotsna is one of the founders of Farm Vaidya and contributes to the organization’s mission and vision.<SEP>G Jyotsna is the Co-Founder and COO of Farm Vaidya, equipped with an MBA in Agri-Business and over 15 years of professional experience in agriculture.

Generative AI
Generative AI refers to the technology used by Farm Vaidya for creating conversational voice agents and agricultural solutions.

Dr Ramadugu Praveen
Dr Ramadugu Praveen is one of the founders of Farm Vaidya involved in developing agricultural solutions.<SEP>Dr Ramadugu Praveen is the Founder and CEO of Farm Vaidya, holding a PhD in Horticulture and extensive experience in various agricultural roles.

Mobile Application Voice Agent
The Mobile Application Voice Agent is an app-based solution providing agricultural assistance through conversational AI on mobile devices.

Inclusive Technology Business Incubator
The Inclusive Technology Business Incubator (ITBI) is an organization focused on fostering inclusive technology innovations at GITAM University in Visakhapatnam.

MVP
The MVP (Minimum Viable Product) is delivered within 72 hours of prototype validation, enabling real-world testing and early adoption.

Prototype
The Prototype is an initial model that allows for quick validation of ideas and use cases within 24 hours.

Building Voice Agents
Building Voice Agents refers to the development process involving the creation and validation of voice agents for various applications.

Enterprise Grade Solutions
Enterprise Grade Solutions refers to more advanced solutions that are delivered within 7 working days of MVP validation.

GITAM University
GITAM University is an educational institution located in Visakhapatnam, associated with the Inclusive Technology Business Incubator.

Conversational Agricultural Audio
The Conversational Agricultural Audio is a dataset comprising 30,000 hours of agricultural dialogue collected from 59 districts to capture local dialects and speech variations.

IIM Visakhapatnam
IIM Visakhapatnam is another educational institution mentioned in the context of technology and incubation initiatives.

Andhra Pradesh
Andhra Pradesh is a state in India where the services provided by Farm Vaidya will directly empower farmers.

Generative AI Voice Technology
Generative AI Voice Technology refers to the AI-driven systems developed by Farm Vaidya to facilitate agricultural communication and knowledge dissemination.

Telangana
Telangana is another state in India benefiting from the agricultural solutions offered by Farm Vaidya.

International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI)
The International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI) provides strategic advice for Farm Vaidya on Generative AI solutions for global agriculture.

Voice Agents
Voice Agents are AI-driven systems developed by Farm Vaidya to assist farmers in obtaining agricultural information and advice through voice interactions.

Voice and Chat Interactions
Voice and Chat Interactions provide built-in analytics that offer insights into customer queries and product demand within the agricultural ecosystem.

Agri-Tech Companies
Agri-Tech Companies are organizations that engage with Farm Vaidya to provide voice solutions to farmers and enhance agricultural services.

Farmers
Farmers are the primary beneficiaries of the solutions offered by Farm Vaidya, utilizing conversational voice agents for farming-related inquiries.
